title: How Chime is redefining marketing through AI
summary_lines: Vineet Mehra, Chief Marketing Officer at Chime, shares how AI is reshaping marketing into an agent-driven discipline. He explains why CMOs who champion AI literacy and thoughtful adoption will lead in the new era of growth.
